name: Cayton Bay Holiday Park (Parkdean Resorts)
stayType: Holiday park with caravans and lodges
accommodation: Caravans, lodges and hot tub lodges
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting on-site facilities
dogs: Dog-friendly accommodation available; Woof park dog agility area
beachAccess: Sandy beach described as a short stroll away
confirmedFeatures: Indoor pool, splash pool, adventure golf, high ropes, bar and restaurant, takeaway, shop, Wi-Fi
overview: A large Parkdean Resorts park just inland of Cayton Bay, between Scarborough and Filey, with caravans, lodges and hot tub lodges. Facilities include an indoor pool, adventure golf, high ropes and a bar and restaurant, and the operator says the sandy beach is a short stroll away.
surfTripFit: The closest big park to Cayton Bay, so you can walk down to check the surf and return to a hot tub lodge.
